resources.string: Hides other people\'s names, photos and phone numbers on this screen so you can stream or share it. Your own name and photo stay visible. Names become a stable code (User 3F2A) so you can still tell chats apart. Notifications show \"New message\" with no sender, like a passcode-locked app. Nothing is sent or changed on the server. Messages themselves are not hidden. Quick toggle: the ⋮ menu on the chat list. Block screen capture makes the whole app black in screenshots, recordings and screen shares.
